body.zh-Hant: 據波蘭國家記憶研究院（IPN）出版的傳記，安德斯在1926年皮蘇斯基發動五月政變時站在政府一方，但勝利後並未受到報復，不久即出任駐羅夫諾的第2獨立騎兵旅旅長。四年後他改任駐布羅迪的邊區騎兵旅旅長，1937年又轉任駐巴拉諾維奇的諾沃格魯代克騎兵旅旅長；該文並稱三年前他已晉升為准將。1939年9月1日戰爭爆發時，他人在利茲巴克。
body.en: According to the biography published by the Polish Institute of National Remembrance (IPN), Anders sided with the government during Piłsudski's May coup of 1926 but suffered no reprisals after the Marshal's victory, and was soon appointed commander of the II Independent Cavalry Brigade at Równe. Four years later he took over the Kresowa Cavalry Brigade at Brody, and in 1937 the Nowogródek Cavalry Brigade at Baranowicze; the text adds that he had been promoted to brigadier general three years earlier. The war broke out on 1 September 1939 while he was at Lidzbark.

citations.quote: Podczas przewrotu majowego Józefa Piłsudskiego w 1926 r.
wkrótce został mianowany dowódcą II Samodzielnej Brygady Kawalerii w Równem
w 1937 r. Nowogródzkiej Brygady Kawalerii w Baranowiczach
Trzy lata wcześniej awansowano go do stopnia generała brygady
Wybuch wojny 1 września 1939 r. zastał gen. Andersa w Lidzbarku

body.zh-Hant: 1939年9月3日至4日夜間，安德斯所屬的諾沃格魯代克騎兵旅開始撤退，目標是在普沃茨克渡過維斯瓦河。9月10日他被編入華沙集團軍，並獲得騎兵作戰集群的指揮權，負責防守華沙以南的維斯瓦河。9月22日該旅在克拉斯諾布魯德突破南下；9月27日他在沃拉蘇德科夫斯卡與蘇軍激戰，之後解散部隊，最終在隔日左右負傷被俘。
body.en: On the night of 3–4 September 1939 Anders's Nowogródek Cavalry Brigade began its retreat with the task of crossing to the left bank of the Vistula at Płock. On 10 September he was subordinated to the commander of Army "Warszawa" and received command of the cavalry operational group, tasked with defending the Vistula south of Warsaw. On 22 September the brigade broke through at Krasnobród to the south; on 27 September he fought a heavy battle with Soviet troops at Wola Sudkowska, then disbanded his units and was captured wounded shortly afterwards.

heading.en: The Polish Army in the USSR

body.zh-Hant: 依IPN傳記，安德斯在盧比揚卡監獄被關到1941年8月。1941年8月10日，總理兼總司令西科爾斯基指派他出任在蘇聯組建的波蘭軍隊指揮官，並於隔日將他晉升為少將（師級將軍）。該文把他稱為由囚犯與流放者組成的「蘇聯波蘭軍」的指揮官。
body.en: According to the IPN biography, Anders was held in the Lubyanka prison until August 1941. On 10 August 1941 Prime Minister and Commander-in-Chief Sikorski designated him commander of the Polish army being formed in the USSR and promoted him to major general the following day. The text describes him as commander of the "Polish Army in the USSR", made up of prisoners and deportees.

citations.quote: Na Łubiance był więziony do sierpnia 1941 r.
Sikorski wyznaczył 10 sierpnia Władysława Andersa
którego dzień później awansował do stopnia generała dywizji

heading.zh-Hant: 義大利戰場與蒙特卡西諾

body.zh-Hant: IPN傳記指出，波蘭第2軍在1943至1944年之交從埃及轉運至義大利南部。1944年5月11日傍晚發動的攻擊先遭擊退，5月17日第二次進攻成功，18日波蘭國旗插上蒙特卡西諾修道院廢墟。該軍此後一路作戰，1945年4月攻佔博洛尼亞；1946年5月，第2軍宣布復員。
body.en: The IPN biography states that the Polish II Corps was transported from Egypt to southern Italy around the turn of 1943–44. The attack launched at dusk on 11 May 1944 was first repulsed, but a second assault on 17 May succeeded and on 18 May the Polish flag was raised over the ruins of the Monte Cassino monastery. The corps ended its combat path with the capture of Bologna in April 1945; in May 1946 the demobilisation of II Corps was announced.

Atak rozpoczął się o zmroku 11 maja 1944 r.
18 maja 1944 r. na ruinach klasztoru Monte Cassino
kończąc swój szlak bojowy zdobyciem Bolonii w kwietniu 1945 r.
Już w maju 1946 r. jednak ogłoszono demobilizację 2. Korpusu

heading.en: Training and command of the 4th Army Corps

body.zh-Hant: 據 bucharest.ro 刊載的專文，普雷贊曾赴法國楓丹白露的砲兵工兵應用學校就讀。1914年他晉升為師級將軍，並被任命為司令部設在雅西的第4軍軍長。第一次世界大戰爆發之初，他曾獲邀出任總參謀長，但選擇留在第4軍軍長之位。
body.en: According to an article on bucharest.ro, Prezan attended the Artillery and Engineer Application School at Fontainebleau in France. In 1914 he was promoted to divisional general and appointed commander of the 4th Army Corps, headquartered in Iași. In the early period of the First World War he was offered the post of Chief of the General Staff but chose to remain at the head of the 4th Army Corps.

citations.quote: courses of the Artillery and Engineer Application School in Fontainebleau
in 1914 he was promoted to the rank of divisional general
appointed commander of the 4th Army Corps, headquartered in Iași

heading.zh-Hant: 1916年戰役與阿爾傑什—內亞夫洛夫會戰
heading.en: The 1916 campaign and the Argeș–Neajlov battle

body.zh-Hant: 1916年8月14日（舊曆）／27日羅馬尼亞參戰，普雷贊受命指揮第4軍，任務是越過東喀爾巴阡山。到九月底，他所部深入敵境約130公里；其後中央同盟國反攻，羅軍撤退。羅馬尼亞統帥部在阿爾傑什河與內亞夫洛夫河一線組織會戰，並把集團軍指揮權交給普雷贊。但此役未能奏效，1916年12月6日布加勒斯特被敵軍佔領。
body.en: When Romania entered the war on 14/27 August 1916, Prezan received command of the 4th Army, tasked with crossing the Eastern Carpathians. By the end of September his troops had advanced about 130 kilometres into enemy territory; the Central Powers' offensive then forced a retreat. The Romanian command organised the battle on the Argeș and Neajlov rivers, entrusting command of the army group to Prezan. The plan failed, and on 6 December 1916 Bucharest was occupied by the enemy.

citations.quote: into the war on August 14/27, 1916
General Prezan received command of the 4th Army
advanced about 130 kilometers into enemy territory
entrusting command of the army group to General Prezan
On December 6, 1916, Bucharest was occupied by the enemy.

heading.zh-Hant: 大本營參謀長與1917年夏季會戰
heading.en: Chief of the Great Headquarters and the 1917 campaign

body.zh-Hant: 1916年12月，普雷贊晉升為軍團將軍，並出任大本營（Great Headquarters）首長，負責把羅軍撤往摩爾達維亞並重整。1917年夏季的馬拉什蒂（Mărăști）攻勢由亞維列斯庫將軍指揮，馬拉謝什蒂與奧伊圖茲則是防禦戰。1918年4月，他在強加於羅馬尼亞的和約背景下被列入預備役；同年秋天他重新執掌大本營，直到1920年大本營解散。
body.en: In December 1916 Prezan was promoted to general of army corps and appointed Chief of the Great Headquarters, charged with withdrawing the army into Moldavia and reorganising it. The offensive at Mărăști in summer 1917 was led by General Averescu, while Mărășești and Oituz were defensive battles. In April 1918 Prezan was placed in reserve in the context of the peace imposed on Romania; in autumn 1918 he returned to the leadership of the Great Headquarters, which was dissolved in 1920.

people.name: Eremia Grigorescu
people.nameZh: 埃雷米亞·格利戈雷斯庫

body.zh-Hant: 據 bucharest.ro 專文，埃雷米亞·格利戈雷斯庫1863年11月28日生於加拉茨縣特爾古布戎附近的戈拉謝伊村。Europe Centenary 的文章稱他1884年畢業於布加勒斯特軍官學校砲兵科，之後被派往法國進修。
body.en: According to an article on bucharest.ro, Eremia Grigorescu was born on 28 November 1863 in the village of Golășei near Târgu Bujor. An Europe Centenary article says he graduated from the artillery section of the officers' military school in Bucharest in 1884 and was then sent to France for advanced training.

citations.quote: was born on November 28, 1863, in the village of Golășei
military school of officers in Bucharest in 1884

body.zh-Hant: 1916年8月羅馬尼亞參戰時，格利戈雷斯庫出任第15步兵師師長。Europe Centenary 稱該師駐在多布羅加，面對保加利亞、德國與土耳其軍的進攻；bucharest.ro 則寫他在多布羅加的穆爾喬瓦與阿拉巴吉戰鬥中擊敗保、德軍，隨後該師被調往摩爾達維亞南部的奧伊圖茲，打了三場決定性戰鬥並穩住戰線。
body.en: When Romania entered the war in August 1916, Grigorescu became commander of the 15th Infantry Division. Europe Centenary says the division was based in Dobrogea and faced attacking German, Turkish and Bulgarian troops; bucharest.ro adds that he won major victories over Bulgarian and German forces in the battles of Mulciova and Arabagi in Dobrogea, after which the division was sent to Oituz in southern Moldavia, where it won three decisive battles and stabilised the front.

citations.quote: Grigorescu became Commander of the 15th Infantry Division
He was in command of the 15th Infantry Division, based in Dobrogea
Battles of Mulciova and Arabagi in Dobrogea
led his division in the Battle of Oituz
won three decisive battles, stabilizing the front

body.zh-Hant: bucharest.ro 稱格利戈雷斯庫在1917年7月被派往納莫洛阿薩出任第6軍軍長，並說1917年7月24日至8月22日間他的第15師在馬拉什蒂、馬拉謝什蒂與奧伊圖茲取得三場重大勝利。Europe Centenary 則記載第1軍團先由康斯坦丁·克里斯泰斯庫將軍指揮到7月30日／8月12日，其後由格利戈雷斯庫接任，並贏得這場勝利。
body.en: bucharest.ro says Grigorescu was sent to Nămoloasa in July 1917 as commander of the VI Army Corps, and that between 24 July and 22 August 1917 his 15th Infantry Division achieved three major victories at Mărăști, Mărășești and Oituz. Europe Centenary records that the 1st Army was led by General Constantin Cristescu until 30 July / 12 August and then by General Eremia Grigorescu, who won the battle.

citations.quote: sent to Nămoloasa as commander of the VI Army Corps
three major victories between July 24–August 22, 1917
until July 30/ August 12
and then by General Eremia Grigorescu

body.zh-Hant: Europe Centenary 記載，格利戈雷斯庫曾短暫加入康斯坦丁·科安達將軍領導的內閣，擔任戰爭部長（1918年10月24日至11月28日）。bucharest.ro 載明他在1918年1月24日晉升為軍團將軍（army general）。該文稱他在戰爭結束後不久、55歲時死於西班牙流感。
body.en: Europe Centenary records that he was briefly part of the government led by General Constantin Coandă as Minister of War (24 October – 28 November 1918). bucharest.ro states he was promoted to army general on 24 January 1918. The article says he died shortly after the end of the war, at the age of 55, of Spanish flu.

body.zh-Hant: 據 WorldWar2.ro 的人物頁，皮埃爾·杜米特斯庫1882年2月18日生於多爾日縣的多布里多爾。1901年他進入砲兵與工兵軍官學校，之後入讀軍事學院，並於1913年畢業。
body.en: According to the WorldWar2.ro biography page, Petre Dumitrescu was born on 18 February 1882 in Dobridor, Dolj. In 1901 he began the courses at the Artillery and Engineers Officers School and later entered the Military Academy, which he finished in 1913.

heading.en: 1941: the Third Army in the East

body.zh-Hant: WorldWar2.ro 載明，1941年3月25日中將杜米特斯庫接掌第3軍團，並幾乎在整個對蘇戰爭期間指揮它。1941年戰局中，該軍團重新佔領北布科維納並渡過德涅斯特河，隨後參加亞速海戰役。
body.en: WorldWar2.ro states that on 25 March 1941 Lieutenant General Petre Dumitrescu took over the 3rd Army, which he commanded practically throughout the anti-Soviet war. In the 1941 campaign his army reoccupied Northern Bukovina, crossed the Dniester and took part in the Battle of the Azov Sea.

citations.quote: On 25 March 1941, lt. general Petre Dumitrescu took over the 3rd Army
his army reoccupied Northern Bukovina
There it took part in the Battle of the Azov Sea

body.zh-Hant: WorldWar2.ro 稱他在1942年7月18日晉升上將。波魯（Boaru）發表於羅馬尼亞科學院期刊的論文指出，1942年8月31日仍在高加索的第3軍團司令收到命令，接防中頓河防線。WorldWar2.ro 寫道，軍團司令部與部分部隊被調到史達林格勒以北的地段；11月19日蘇聯西南方面軍發動冬季攻勢。
body.en: WorldWar2.ro says he was promoted to general on 18 July 1942. A paper by Gheorghe Boaru in an Academy of Romanian Scientists journal notes that on 31 August 1942 the commander of the 3rd Army, still in the Caucasus, received the order to take over the defence of the Middle Don. WorldWar2.ro adds that the army command and part of the units were moved to the sector north of Stalingrad, and that on 19 November 1942 the Soviet South-Western Front launched its winter offensive.

body.zh-Hant: WorldWar2.ro 記載，他的部隊曾組成「杜米特斯庫集團軍」。蘇聯第3烏克蘭方面軍於1944年8月20日發動攻勢；他在1944年8月23日事變後約三週被迫退役。1946年5月15日他被控戰爭罪受審，後因缺乏有力證據獲判無罪，並於1950年1月15日在布加勒斯特家中去世。
body.en: WorldWar2.ro records that he commanded "Army Group Dumitrescu". The Soviet 3rd Ukrainian Front began its offensive on 20 August 1944; he was retired three weeks after the events of 23 August 1944. On 15 May 1946 he was tried on war-crimes charges, eventually acquitted for lack of solid evidence, and he died at home in Bucharest on 15 January 1950.

heading.zh-Hant: 1939年12月：受命指揮蘇奧穆薩爾米一帶部隊
heading.en: December 1939: appointed to command at Suomussalmi

body.zh-Hant: 據 talvisota.fi 的蘇奧穆薩爾米戰役頁面，1939年12月7日總司令部把第27步兵團撥歸北芬蘭集群，該團屬於駐在奧盧一帶的第9師。第9師師長西拉斯沃上校被任命為一個旅的指揮官，旅由一個步兵團與部分師屬戰鬥支援部隊組成。已在蘇奧穆薩爾米地區的所有部隊也一併歸他指揮，這些部隊被編為「西拉斯沃集群」。
body.en: According to the talvisota.fi page on the Battle of Suomussalmi, on 7 December 1939 the General Headquarters subordinated the 27th Infantry Regiment to the North Finland Group; the regiment belonged to the 9th Division, stationed in the Oulu area. The division's commander, Colonel Hjalmar Siilasvuo, was appointed commander of a brigade formed from an infantry regiment and part of the division's combat support troops. All troops already deployed in the Suomussalmi area were also subordinated to him and formed into Group Siilasvuo.

citations.quote: On 7 December, the General Headquarters subordinated an infantry regiment
Colonel Hjalmar Siilasvuo, was appointed commander of a brigade
The forces in the Suomussalmi area were formed into Group Siilasvuo.

heading.zh-Hant: 拉特路的封鎖與收復蘇奧穆薩爾米的攻勢
heading.en: The Raate road block and attempts to retake Suomussalmi

body.zh-Hant: 增援部隊抵達後，西拉斯沃集群於12月11日發動包圍攻擊，目標是奪回蘇奧穆薩爾米。該目標未能達成，但集群封鎖了蘇奧穆薩爾米以東通往庫奧馬湖與庫伊瓦斯湖之間地峽的道路。該頁並說，為奪回蘇奧穆薩爾米而發動的攻勢一直持續到聖誕節。
body.en: After reinforcements arrived in the Suomussalmi area, Group Siilasvuo launched its encirclement attack on 11 December with the aim of retaking Suomussalmi. The goal was not achieved, but the group blocked the road leading east from Suomussalmi on the isthmus between Lake Kuormajärvi and Lake Kuivasjärvi. The page adds that the offensives aimed at retaking Suomussalmi continued until Christmas.

citations.quote: launched their encirclement attack on 11 December
blocked the road leading east from Suomussalmi
Offensives launched in order to retake Suomussalmi continued until Christmas.

heading.en: Late December: the new 9th Division and the Soviet withdrawal

body.zh-Hant: 12月底更多部隊集中到蘇奧穆薩爾米地區，在西拉斯沃指揮下新編成第9師，但該師缺乏大部分砲兵。12月27日起，為這次攻勢編成的卡里集群從西面進攻胡爾科涅米；該集群的進攻使敵軍師於12月29日撤出蘇奧穆薩爾米。
body.en: More troops were concentrated in the Suomussalmi area at the end of December and a new 9th Division was formed under Siilasvuo, though it lacked most of its artillery. Group Kari, formed for the offensive, attacked Hulkonniemi from the west starting 27 December, and its offensive led the enemy division to withdraw from Suomussalmi on 29 December.
